leadText: Magikarp Journey (Japanese: コイキングの魔法でキレイになるっ!?, I'll Become Beautiful with Magic!?), is the second bonus chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.
plainText:
Magikarp Journey (Japanese: コイキングの魔法でキレイになるっ!?, I'll Become Beautiful with Magic!?), is the second bonus chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Hazel and Coconut read in a magazine about a failsafe love potion -- take one whisker of and seal it in a pouch, and presto! Lacking the money to order prepackaged whiskers, they journey to the bottom of the sea.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Hazel
Coconut

Grandpa
